remarks: OPPORTUNITY AWAITS IN LEDUC'S DESIRABLE TRIBUTE COMMUNITY! Located on a quiet crescent, this spacious 2-storey home offers great square footage with 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a double attached garage. The functional layout features a welcoming foyer, living room with gas fireplace, spacious kitchen, adjoining dining area, and convenient main-floor laundry. Upstairs offers 3 bedrooms, including a primary suite with walk-in closet and ensuite. The fully finished basement provides a recreation room, 4th bedroom, and additional bathroom. Outside features a fenced yard and rear deck. Ideally situated near schools, parks, playgrounds, shopping, and amenities. A fantastic opportunity for investors or buyers looking for potential in an established neighbourhood! (id:67522)
